premises.text: Consumer product companies have no targeting and misspend half their marketing budgets
Barcode check-ins with social sharing, Fanships, dragon quips, and comic unlocks form one consumer engagement product
premises.evidence_span: Snapdragon is product check-ins with a twist. It's product check-ins that unlock a comic book adventure

premises.text: Check-in data lets CPG marketers target promotions and loyalty rewards correctly
premises.evidence_span: giving consumer product marketers the targeting tools that they need

premises.text: Marketers still rely on mass printed Sunday-paper coupons that cannot target
premises.evidence_span: an industry that still prints millions upon millions of coupons and stuffs them into Sunday papers each week

value.text: Reinvent how consumer product companies market to customers with targeting wrapped in a fun game
value.evidence_span: we want to fundamentally reinvent how consumer product companies market to their customers

secondary_value.text: Consumers get hooked on a fun product check-in gaming experience
secondary_value.evidence_span: wrapping the whole thing in this fun gaming experience

causal_links.evidence_span: product check-ins that unlock a comic book adventure
giving consumer product marketers the targeting tools that they need

notes: Fanship, Quips, and comics folded into one offering premise per §4.1(5). Sunday-paper coupon practice kept as continuing industry condition with the targeting gap. No financing ask present.
